name: Harbor Freight Credit Card

apr.notes: Purchase APR is prime + 24.24% (30.99% as of January 1, 2026); penalty APR prime + 34.24%.

base_rate.description: 5 reward points per $1 in net purchases (excluding equal pay purchases).

rewards.redemption_notes: Every 500 points issues a $5 Harbor Freight Money certificate.

notes: Issued by Synchrony Bank and usable at Harbor Freight Tools. Equal-payment purchases of $299 or more carry 0% interest and do not earn points. It is a closed-loop private-label card that does not run on a payment network, so network is other and network_tier is none.
